oracle.name: Microsoft.PowerApps.CLI (PAC) Power Fx evaluator
oracle.scope: Scalar expressions of the 193-case language matrix evaluated by the official PAC 2.13.1 evaluator twice in distinct empty-authentication profiles. The fixture records no host context for these runs, so Mirage uses its default host.

input.expression: With({a: 1, b: 0}, IfError(a/b, If(FirstError.Kind <> ErrorKind.Div0, Error(FirstError), -1)))
Match("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.", "THE", MatchOptions.IgnoreCase).StartMatch
CountRows(MatchAll("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.", "the", MatchOptions.IgnoreCase))
Concat(ForAll(Sequence(2) As Rank, Concat(ForAll(Sequence(2) As File, If(Mod(Rank.Value + File.Value, 2) = 1, "X", ".")), Value) & "|"), Value)
